body:
# 📦 UltraDrawer

**UltraDrawer** is a high-performance storage plugin inspired by popular drawer mods, designed to simplify item management on your Minecraft server.

🔹 Store **huge amounts of a single item** in one compact block  
🔹 Enjoy a **clean visual display** with floating items and live counters   
🔹 Fully compatible with **hoppers & automation systems**  
🔹 Optimized for **modern Minecraft versions (1.21+)**  
🔹 Lightweight, configurable, and survival-friendly  

---
| Command | Arguments | Description | Permission |
|--------|----------|------------|------------|
| `/drawer give <player>` | `player`: target player | Gives 1 drawer item to a player | `drawer.give` |
---
## USAGE
![drawer usage](https://media1.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExc2d6dGZ6cDFoZ2k3czVtNnM1enQ4a3N5NHNkYnZ5OWdlbDBtaXJzZiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/NowEGQ4KwpJmYddNKC/giphy.gif)
## DRAWER + HOPPER + REDSTONE
![drawer hopper](https://media4.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExaWU2NDdwY3U1bXg1eGx3MXYzYXdkcXBjcGV1Nmc4cXZyNHV3dzE2NCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/L0UcMRndZnMSTzfM5x/giphy.gif)

UltraDrawer brings the comfort of modded storage to **vanilla-like servers**, with smooth interactions, intuitive controls, and powerful backend logic.

> Simple on the outside. Massive on the inside. 💎📦

Perfect for survival, skyblock, and technical servers looking for **efficient and elegant storage solutions**.
